clips.title: A Loud Greeting at Reception
grammar: んじゃない — isn't it / shouldn't you
〜ていただく — humbly receive an action

lines.ja: おはようございます。あの…
lines.en: Good morning. Um...
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.en: Good morning!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: 声が小さいんじゃないのかい？
lines.en: Isn't your voice a bit too quiet?
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: お、おはようございます！
lines.en: G-good morning!
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.en: Louder!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: Good morning!
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.en: Louder!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: Good morning!
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.en: Good morning!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: His voice is so loud...! Um...
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.ja: あんたは誰だい？自己紹介くらいできんだろ？
lines.en: Who are you? You can at least introduce yourself, right?
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: 本日からこちらの会社の受付嬢…
lines.en: Starting today, as a receptionist at this company...
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.en: Too quiet!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: 本日からこちらの会社の受付嬢として働かせていただくことになりました、上村と申します！
lines.en: Starting today, I will be working as a receptionist at this company. My name is Kamimura!
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.en: Greet people properly.
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: みんな見てるよ。評判悪くなる前に、
lines.en: Everyone is watching. Before your reputation suffers,
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: say hello to me!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: 社長になったってなぁ、人に挨拶、
lines.en: Even if you became the president, greet people,
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: and greet animals!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: Greet everything!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: All creation!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: Above heaven and below heaven, I alone am honored!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: Show gratitude to all things,
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: and don't forget to greet them!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: Once you understand that, get to work!
lines.speaker: Senior

clips.title: The Company's Midfielder
grammar: 〜ないと — must do (short for 〜ないといけない)
〜みたいなもん — something like / akin to
〜わけ — that is why / the meaning is

lines.ja: あの、今の場合って、その、内線でこう呼んだりとかっていう…
lines.en: Um, in a case like that, couldn't you call them on the intercom...?
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.ja: ああ、そんなのめんどくせえでしょ！
lines.en: Ah, that's just a pain, right?!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: この取って、プルルって回すあの時間が。
lines.en: Picking it up, turning the dial, all that wasted time.
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: 短縮しないと。受付嬢は全て短縮！わかる？
lines.en: We must cut down time. Receptionists cut everything down! Get it?
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.en: Ah, yes!
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.en: I make all the judgments right here.
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: 私が全てパスを出すわけ。
lines.en: Meaning, I pass to everyone.
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: ミッドフィルダーみたいなもんよ、この会社の！
lines.en: I'm basically like the midfielder of this company!
lines.speaker: Senior

lines.ja: そういうポジションなんですね。
lines.en: Oh, so that's the kind of position it is.
lines.speaker: Kamimura

lines.ja: そうよ！私が、この会社の中村俊輔だ！
lines.en: That's right! I am the Shunsuke Nakamura of this company!
lines.speaker: Senior
